profile.ja: 米連と日本の消防当局が協力して開発した消防車兼消火用耐火パワードスーツ。サイレンを鳴らして現場に急行し、到着すればパワードスーツ（というかロボ）に変形して消火活動にあたる。救助より消火に特化していて、数千度の高熱にも耐える耐熱力と、障害物を破壊するための装備とパワーを持ち、化学テロや化学工場火災といった特殊な火炎の中にも入って火元に直接アプローチすることを期待されている。また、兵器への応用も密かに研究されているとか。
profile.en: They are a fire truck and a fire-resistant powered suit developed in cooperation with the American and Japanese fire departments. They rush to the scene with their sirens blaring and transform into a powered suit - or rather, a robot - to engage in firefighting activities upon arrival. They specialize in firefighting rather than rescue, possessing heat-resistant capabilities that can withstand temperatures of several thousand degrees, as well as equipment and power to destroy obstacles. They are expected to directly approach the source of the fire, even in special flames such as chemical terrorism or chemical plant fires. Additionally, their application as a weapon is being secretly researched.

text.ja: ヨミハラ消防１課１班所属！　ＳＢ－００１、通称“炎王”！　『火急の依頼』との通報を受け参上！！　火元はどこだ！？
text.en: I'm with the Yomiha Fire Department, 1st Division, 1st Team! I'm SB-001, also known as the Flame King! I've received a report of a 'fire emergency' and I'm here to respond! Where's the fire?

text.ja: どんな非道な手を使っても、必ず！　火を！　消す！　それが私！　炎王だ！　火事の時はいつでも呼んでくれ！
text.en: No matter what it takes, I'll definitely put out the fire! That's what I do - I'm the Flame King! Call me anytime there's a fire!

text.ja: 任務の時以外は炎王からおりたらどうかだと？　そんな事をしたら全能感が失われ……げふん！　いざという時に急行できんではないか！
text.en: You're saying I should take off the Flame King suit when I'm not on a mission? If I did that, I'd lose my sense of omnipotence... Ha! What if I couldn't respond in time when an emergency arises?

text.ja: 今、周囲１００メートルを真空状態にして広範囲を消火する装置を開発中だ。……人がいたら？　何を言っている。焼死よりは楽に死ねるだろう？
text.en: I'm currently developing a device that can create a vacuum state within a 100-meter radius to extinguish fires over a wide area... What if there are people around? Don't be ridiculous - it's better to die quickly than to burn to death, isn't it?

text.ja: 何、火事だと！？　どこだ、早く言え！　急いで向かわなければ、誰かが消してしまったり消えてしまったりするかもしれんではないか！
text.en: What's going on - is there a fire?! Where is it?! Tell me quickly! If I don't hurry, someone might put it out or it might be gone before I arrive!

text.ja: 火事はどこだ、火事はないか？　本当にないのか、隠すとためにならんぞ！　チッ、ないならないで火付けの一つでもせんか。気の利かないヤツめ
text.en: Is there a fire? Really, is there no fire? Don't hide it - it won't do you any good! Ugh, if there isn't one, why don't you just start one? You're really inconsiderate.

text.ja: ハァハァ……ふぅ……すみませんね、火事と聞くとつい見境がなくなっちゃって。この前も火事を消すためにビルを二つほど破壊してしまいまして
text.en: Ha ha ha... *pant*... Sorry about that - when I hear about a fire, I just lose my composure. Last time, I destroyed two buildings while trying to put out a fire...

text.ja: 消火液を作る為に水の精霊の女王に拷問をしている？　ハハハ、それは以前の話だよ。今は効率を上げる為投薬で涙を止まらなくさせているのさ
text.en: You're saying I'm torturing the Nymph Queen to create fire extinguishing liquid? Hahaha, that's old news. Now, I'm using medication to make her cry uncontrollably - it's all about efficiency.
